coverage_decision: All main-text figures/tables and all supplementary result tables/figures material to interpretation were reconciled. The protocol/SAP was used for design, endpoint, amendment and analysis provenance rather than atomizing operational administration minutiae.
omissions_and_reasons: Pure bibliography pages were excluded from ATOM and retained in the reference task queue.
Protocol operational details unrelated to trial interpretation, endpoint definition, analysis, safety, or reproducibility were not atomized.
Not every exploratory/tertiary protocol endpoint was atomized because the 2015 article did not report those results.
